content:
The image shows a mango leaf with whitish-grey powdery patches distributed across the surface. The patches are diffuse and dusty in appearance, consistent with fungal spore colonies on the leaf surface. There are no sunken brown spots (ruling out Anthracnose), no black sooty encrustation (ruling out Sooty Mould), and no bark/twig withering (ruling out Die Back).

The white-grey powdery coating distributed across the leaf surface is the hallmark sign of Powdery Mildew.
